objective: A frozen census of 180 growth runs (three rules, three closing biases, ten seeds, NAE and the clause law): pairs in three or more knots, pinched links, closing degrees, closed surfaces; predictions P1 to P5 as registered.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-11 (frozen, exact per move): 180 growth runs. Faithful growth does not supply the count: under free, pairs in three or more knots in every run that grew past a tetrahedron (26 of 30); under open, pinched links in 17 of 30; under disc, closed degrees 3 to 14, no run mostly at 6, no flat closed surface. NAE refused all 89 degree-3 closings inside larger worlds (proved: adjacent apices). P2 to P4 hold; P1 and P5 failed only on worlds that closed into a tetrahedron. A corrected supplement gives identical verdicts.
title: Faithful growth and the count of how knots meet
